title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Classroom Chalkboard. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Classroom Chalkboard
options.lineage: slate board, chalk dust, eraser smudges
options.thesis: A slate canvas where the timeline is drawn in chalk and the dust settles where work happened.
options.viewport: Dark slate canvas, chalk-drawn axis, chalk event cards, dust texture.
options.risk: Reads dated or classroom-cliché if the chalk is decorative rather than structural.

raised.raise: Type scale is measured and ranked, not guessed, so chalk sizes stay legible.
Hard side-by-side halves for the compare view, like side A / side B.
Relation arrows bend at 45/90 with interchange nodes, like a transit line.
A relation layer rides over the terrain of the timeline without editing it.

options.label: Cork Pin-Board
options.lineage: cork bulletin board, pinned cards, colored string
options.thesis: Events pinned to cork, connected by colored string, like a student's evidence wall.
options.viewport: Cork canvas with pinned index-card events and string relation arrows.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on; can read craft-fair if the pins are literal.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.lineage: metro map fired as enamel mural
options.thesis: A midnight-blue shell where causal relations read as transit lines with interchange nodes.
options.viewport: Midnight-blue work surface, standard controls, transit-line relation arrows.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: relations map to transit lines with 45/90 bends; loses narrowly on audience identification (commuter vs student).
options.risk: Reads as a transit app, not a study tool, if the shell goes cold.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.case: Fuses poorly: a specimen showcases type, not a task; students do not identify with it.
options.kept: Measured type scale and ranked faces.

options.label: Cassette J-Card
options.case: Fuses poorly: side A/B halves and track times do not read as a timeline tool.
options.kept: Hard halves for the compare view (side A vs side B).

options.label: Vertical Video Feed
options.case: Fuses poorly: one-item-at-a-time navigation breaks the timeline's overview.
options.kept: Full-bleed focus for the empty/first-run state.

options.label: Metro Typographic Tiles
options.case: Fuses poorly: cropped headlines and tile chrome fight the task's data density.
options.kept: Type doing the work of chrome.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.case: Fuses poorly: terrain color language overwhelms the work surface; course layer overlaps the signature move.
options.kept: Layered course-over-terrain model for the relation overlay.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
